description: Edit these four pixel-art popoto figures into one kindly elderly granny clothes seller: standing top left, waving top right, presenting a folded pink shirt bottom left, laughing bottom right. Keep each figure's position, scale, facing, round body proportions and hand positions. Remove the hat, moustache, satchel, fishing rod and watering can completely. Give her a broad silver-grey hair cap with a distinct round top bun, a short wooden hairpin projecting sideways, bold dark half-moon glasses below clearly visible eyes, rosy cheeks and a small smile. Dress her in a plain lavender shawl and cream pocket apron. A broad yellow tape measure hangs in two clear strips against the lavender; chunky scissors show two dark handle loops and short grey blades above the pocket. Keep these shapes separate and readable, without knit texture, brooch or tape markings. Preserve the reference's chunky square pixels, thick dark outlines and few-tone flat shading; no anti-aliasing, blur or gradients. Keep everything inside its original slot with clear gaps between figures. Transparent background, nothing else added.
